[EN] I came across some folklore while researching the arkai. Supposedly Arkai eggs can grant eternal youth to a powerful sorcerer.

Imagine what esteem we would earn if we gave some to Oshar!"I sense a task for me..."
[ES] Me topé con algo de folclore mientras investigaba a los arkai. Supuestamente, los huevos de Arkai pueden otorgar juventud eterna a un poderoso hechicero.

¡Imagina el prestigio que ganaríamos si le diéramos algunos a Oshar!
"I sense a task for me..."

[EN] You're learning to anticipate Oshar's needs, . That's good.

Go around {@LinkCreature:30#1000#Arkai Perch$$Arkaina} and collect eggs.

Be careful. If the {@LinkCreature:30#220#teal arkai} finds you stealing its eggs, it will attack.
[ES] Estás aprendiendo a anticiparte a las necesidades de Oshar, . Eso es bueno.

Ronda {@LinkCreature:30#1000#Arkai Perch$$Arkaina} y recoge huevos.

Ten cuidado. Si el {@LinkCreature:30#220#teal arkai} te descubre robando sus huevos, te atacará.

[EN] Are these the eggs?

They're not as big as I thought they would be. Seem quite ordinary, really.

Should I feed one to a sloth or something first? And if I do, will I have created an immortal sloth-king?
[ES] ¿Son estos los huevos?

No son tan grandes como pensaba. Parecen bastante normales, la verdad.

¿Debería darle uno a un perezoso o algo así primero? Y si lo hago, ¿habré creado un rey perezoso inmortal?

[EN] It's not so much that I want the eggs, you see. Oshar wants them, and we are all just Oshar's servants.
[ES] No es tanto que yo quiera los huevos, ya ves. Oshar los quiere, y todos somos simplemente sirvientes de Oshar.
